# cursor_origin_inbound_ip_allowlist_entries (Data Source)

Lists the entries on an Origin namespace's inbound IP allowlist, oldest first, and whether the namespace enforces it. A namespace lists at most 100 entries. Uses the provider auth token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_origin_inbound_ip_allowlist_entries" "acme" {
  namespace = "acme"
}

output "acme_admitted_cidrs" {
  value = [for entry in data.cursor_origin_inbound_ip_allowlist_entries.acme.entries : entry.cidr if entry.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Slug of the team namespace.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the namespace enforces the allowlist. The list takes effect only while this is true and at least one entry is enabled.
- `entries` (Attributes List) Every entry on the allowlist, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range, spelled as it was submitted.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the entry was added.
- `description` (String) Label for the entry; empty when unset.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the entry admits its addresses. A disabled entry stays listed but admits nothing.
- `id` (String) Origin-assigned entry ID (nsip_...).
